row.name: The Apple Tree Daycare, INC. III

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80%: Director completed 30 annual training hours of which 7 hours were self-study training. The self-study trainings are the required annual training topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80% (26 TAC §746.1309(g))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: An employee was responsible for supervising a group of children; however, this individual does not fulfill the educational requirements necessary to qualify as a caregiver.    Corrected at Inspection: A qualified caregiver was placed in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Three caregivers completed Pediatric CPR training online without hands-on skill-based instruction, and practice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: There was a torn mat used by a child during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There were three vents and ceiling fans with dust and debris.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Employees Know Who Is in Charge: Employees did not know the person in charge in the absence of the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Employees Know Who Is in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director did not have a time sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have a Food Allergy Emergency Plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher was not secured in one of the transportation vehicles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The documentation for the fire drills and sheltering/lockdown drills was not fully completed for 2024. There were several dates missing on the forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The group of toddlers were viewing a children's video while waiting for their meal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: 1 out of 10 employee files reviewed is missing translation of education.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Carbon Monoxide Detector had not been tested for the year 2024.     *This was corrected at inspection when the Carbon Monoxide Detector was tested and in compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: 2 out of 10 employee files reviewed are missing First Aid and CPR Training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Observed documentation of last fire drill conducted on 1-31-24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: 9 out of 10 childrens records reviewed is missing the following:    1) Admission Date  2) Emergency Contact Address, Special Care Statement, Healthcare Provider Statement, Immunization Information  3) Emergency Contact other than a parent   4) Emergency Contact Address, Emergency Care Authorization, Special Care Statement  5) Date of Admission, Special Care Statement   6) Date of Admission,   7) Date of Admission, Name of School/Address/Phone Number  8) Date of Admission, Address of Emergecny Contact, Special Care Statement, School information, Healthcare Statement, Immunization records, Permission to ride bus/walk  9) Iimmunization Records
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: In the infant classroom there was a garbage can that was accessible to the children.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the trash can from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Label Powders, Lotions, Etc. with Name: In the toddler classroom there was an ointment in one of the children's cubbies that was not labeled.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver labeled the diaper ointment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Label Powders, Lotions, Etc. with Name (26 TAC §746.3501(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was observed yelling at a child during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A Pre-K child was observed using caregiver's phone to watch videos not related to planned activities.      NOTE: Phone was removed and activities were resumed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Three out of nine infants were observed sleeping in restrictive devices (swings). Children were not removed as soon as possible.      NOTE: This was corrected by caregivers removing children from restrictive devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Two groups of children were observed watching cartoons on television not related to planned activities.       NOTE: This was corrected by caregivers switching TV shows to material related to planned activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Documentation of education outside of U.S. for one caregiver does not provide proof of high school or GED completion.     Documentation of education outside of U.S. for another caregiver was not translated to English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: A caregiver washed a child's hands in the sink designated to wash dishes and other food items.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: An infant's bottle was being supported by a blanket while infant was feeding on a restrictive device.     NOTE: This was corrected during inspection as infant began to be fed by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Three children under the age for 2 were observed watching television during a transition in the toddler classroom.    NOTE: This was corrected during inspection as television was turned off and another activity was initiated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
